label: Fires at GO after reaching S1, strongest after rewarded a1->S1, graded by S1 belief.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is('a1 S1 r') ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == S2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state != S2) * belief_lo
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == S2) ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == S1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == S1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == -1) * belief_lo
explanation: Active only at GO (zero at D1/D2). Magnitude is set by the previous trial: largest (~+2.3 over timing) after a1->S1 rewarded, small after a1->S1 unrewarded or a2->S1 rewarded, and silenced (~-1, i.e. near zero) whenever the last trial reached S2 (any choice/reward) or after a2->S1 unrewarded. On top of that it grows with the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good. So it reads as an S1-favouring / stay-with-a1 evidence signal. The free fit adds separate weights for the weaker S1 patterns, a belief x S1 interaction, a two-trials-back reward bonus, and belief for the window first trial (dev 0.835 vs short 0.754). No future, hidden, or model-output variables used.

issues: The label says the feature fires at GO 'after reaching S1', but after an unrewarded a2->S1 trial it is silenced (GO residual -1.08, the same as after S2). The explanation mentions this; the label does not.

The belief term in the recorded short form applies at every GO step. In the data, belief only grades the activation when the last trial did not reach S2. After S2 the feature sits near zero whatever the belief. Misses on the recorded short form show two large systematic over-predictions: GO after a1 S2 u by -0.68 and GO after a2 S1 u by -0.57. There is also an under-prediction of +0.32 after a2 S2 r. These are whole previous-trial classes, not scattered noise.

Restricting the belief term to steps where the last state was not S2 lifts test R^2 beyond timing from 0.748 to 0.822. That nearly matches the 8-term free fit (0.828). Its remaining per-class errors are all at most 0.2 (largest +0.20 after a1 S1 u).

The supporting claims hold. The feature is zero at D1 and D2 (all residuals there are +0). It is largest after a rewarded a1->S1 trial (+2.28). It is about -1 after any trial that reached S2. It rises with belief across belief deciles (-1.09 up to +1.55). No future variables are used.

The free fit's 'belief on the window's first trial' term is mostly a window-start correction (prev_action == -1) * belief_lo. It is absorbed by (prev_state != S2) * belief_lo, because steps with an unknown previous trial also have prev_state != S2.
